__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Azure Monitor managed Prometheus or any Prometheus data source.

description: Azure Managed Lustre key operational metrics from vmss-metrics-exporter: OST capacity, MDT capacity/files, client throughput/ops, latency, HSM reliability, freshness, and inventory.

panels.title: Filesystems observed
panels.description: Number of Azure Managed Lustre filesystems in the current selection (subscription, region, resource group, filesystem name). Counted from azure_managed_lustre_filesystem_info so the value honours the dashboard filters.

targets.expr: count(azure_managed_lustre_filesystem_info{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", location=~"$location", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name"})

panels.title: Worst OST available %
panels.description: Worst filesystem-level OST data-capacity pressure signal. The stat keeps the filesystem identity so fleet views show which Lustre filesystem needs attention.

targets.expr: bottomk(1, min by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location) (max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location, ostnum) (azure_managed_lustre_ost_bytes_available_percent{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"})))

panels.title: Worst MDT files free %
panels.description: Worst filesystem-level metadata file/inode exhaustion signal. The stat keeps the filesystem identity for multi-filesystem fleet views.

targets.expr: bottomk(1, min by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location) (max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location, mdtnum) (azure_managed_lustre_mdt_files_free_percent{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"})))

panels.title: Worst MDT bytes available %
panels.description: Worst filesystem-level MDT storage-capacity pressure signal. The stat keeps the filesystem identity for multi-filesystem fleet views.

targets.expr: bottomk(1, min by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location) (max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location, mdtnum) (azure_managed_lustre_mdt_bytes_available_percent{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"})))

panels.title: Collector freshness
panels.description: Seconds since last successful Managed Lustre collection.

targets.expr: time() - max(azure_managed_lustre_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="$job"})

panels.title: Stalest OST sample
panels.description: Oldest filesystem-level Azure Monitor OST sample age in seconds. The stat keeps the filesystem identity for multi-filesystem freshness triage.

targets.expr: topk(1, max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location) (time() - azure_managed_lustre_ost_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

panels.title: Stalest MDT sample
panels.description: Oldest filesystem-level Azure Monitor MDT sample age in seconds. The stat keeps the filesystem identity for multi-filesystem freshness triage.

targets.expr: topk(1, max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location) (time() - azure_managed_lustre_mdt_sample_timestamp_seconds{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"}))

panels.title: Errors 5m rate
panels.description: Rate of failed Managed Lustre collection calls over five minutes.

targets.expr: sum(rate(azure_managed_lustre_collection_errors_total{job="$job"}[5m]))

panels.title: Lowest OST available % trend
panels.description: Bottom-N OST capacity pressure. When Azure Monitor returns aggregate metrics, ostnum is all.

targets.expr: bottomk($top_n, azure_managed_lustre_ost_bytes_available_percent{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"})

panels.title: Lowest MDT files free % trend
panels.description: Bottom-N MDT metadata file/inode pressure.

targets.expr: bottomk($top_n, azure_managed_lustre_mdt_files_free_percent{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"})

panels.title: Lowest MDT bytes available % trend
panels.description: Bottom-N MDT storage pressure.

targets.expr: bottomk($top_n, azure_managed_lustre_mdt_bytes_available_percent{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"})

panels.title: Client read/write throughput by filesystem
panels.description: Client data transfer rate grouped by filesystem.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, sum by (filesystem_name) (azure_managed_lustre_client_read_throughput_bytes_per_second{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

topk($top_n, sum by (filesystem_name) (azure_managed_lustre_client_write_throughput_bytes_per_second{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

panels.title: Client read/write ops by filesystem
panels.description: Client read and write operation counts grouped by filesystem.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, sum by (filesystem_name) (azure_managed_lustre_client_read_ops{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

topk($top_n, sum by (filesystem_name) (azure_managed_lustre_client_write_ops{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

panels.title: OST client latency
panels.description: OST operation latency by filesystem and operation. Values are milliseconds from Azure Monitor OSTClientLatency.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, ostnum, operation) (azure_managed_lustre_ost_client_latency_milliseconds{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

panels.title: OST client ops
panels.description: OST operation count by filesystem and operation from Azure Monitor OSTClientOps. This is a sampled count value, not latency.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, ostnum, operation) (azure_managed_lustre_ost_client_ops{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

panels.title: MDT client latency
panels.description: MDT operation latency by filesystem and operation. Values are milliseconds from Azure Monitor MDTClientLatency.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, mdtnum, operation) (azure_managed_lustre_mdt_client_latency_milliseconds{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"}))

panels.title: MDT client ops
panels.description: MDT operation count by filesystem and operation from Azure Monitor MDTClientOps. This is a sampled count value, not latency.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, mdtnum, operation) (azure_managed_lustre_mdt_client_ops{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"}))

panels.title: Max HSM action errors
panels.description: Maximum HSM action errors across selected MDTs. Any non-zero value should be investigated.

targets.expr: max(azure_managed_lustre_hsm_action_errors{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"})

panels.title: Max HSM in-flight
panels.description: Maximum HSM in-flight requests across selected MDTs. Sustained growth can indicate HSM backlog.

targets.expr: max(azure_managed_lustre_hsm_current_requests{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"})

panels.title: HSM action errors trend
panels.description: Top-N MDTs by HSM action errors (Azure Monitor HSMActionErrors). Non-zero values indicate HSM action failures and should be investigated.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, mdtnum) (azure_managed_lustre_hsm_action_errors{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"}))

panels.title: HSM in-flight requests trend
panels.description: Top-N MDTs by HSM in-flight requests (Azure Monitor HSMCurrentRequests). Sustained growth indicates HSM backlog; the warning reference line uses $hsm_inflight_warn.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, mdtnum) (azure_managed_lustre_hsm_current_requests{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"}))
vector($hsm_inflight_warn)

panels.title: Client connections
panels.description: Connected client (export) counts from Azure Monitor OSTConnectedClients / MDTConnectedClients. Each mounted Lustre client opens one export per MDT and one per OST, so max-by-filesystem of MDT connections approximates the total client count.

panels.title: Max OST clients
panels.description: Maximum OST connected client count (Azure Monitor OSTConnectedClients). Azure Monitor currently exposes only the aggregate ostnum="all" series, so this stat normally equals the single per-filesystem value; kept for spotting the busiest OST once per-OST telemetry is available.

targets.expr: max(azure_managed_lustre_ost_connected_clients{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"})

panels.title: Max MDT clients
panels.description: Maximum MDT connected client count (Azure Monitor MDTConnectedClients). Each mounted client opens one export per MDT, so this approximates the largest client population among selected filesystems. See Derived filesystem signals → Total filesystem clients for the cross-filesystem sum.

targets.expr: max(azure_managed_lustre_mdt_connected_clients{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"})

panels.title: Min OST clients
panels.description: Minimum OST connected client count across selected OSTs. Intended to detect failover, eviction or routing imbalance once per-OST telemetry is available. Today Azure Monitor only exposes aggregate ostnum="all", so this normally tracks Max OST clients.

targets.expr: min(azure_managed_lustre_ost_connected_clients{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"})

panels.title: OST client connections trend
panels.description: Top-N OSTs by connected client count (Azure Monitor OSTConnectedClients). Useful to spot OSTs whose client population diverges from the rest of the filesystem.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, ostnum) (azure_managed_lustre_ost_connected_clients{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

panels.title: MDT client connections trend
panels.description: Top-N MDTs by connected client count (Azure Monitor MDTConnectedClients). max by (filesystem_name) of this series approximates the total mounted Lustre client count per filesystem.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name, mdtnum) (azure_managed_lustre_mdt_connected_clients{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"}))

panels.title: Discovered Lustre filesystems
panels.description: All Azure Managed Lustre filesystems discovered from Resource Graph, including filesystems with no current OST/MDT Azure Monitor samples.

targets.expr: max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location, sku_tier) (azure_managed_lustre_filesystem_info{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location"})

max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location) (azure_managed_lustre_filesystem_storage_capacity_tib{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location"})

panels.title: OST used % vs 75/80 guardrails
panels.description: OST used percentage from Azure Monitor-derived bytes used / total. Warning at 75% and hard-stop/page at 80% per the production best-practices doc.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location, ostnum) (azure_managed_lustre_ost_bytes_used_percent{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", ostnum=~"$ostnum"}))

panels.title: MDT bytes used % vs 75/90 guardrails
panels.description: MDT byte usage. Warning at 75% and critical at 90% per the production best-practices doc.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location, mdtnum) (azure_managed_lustre_mdt_bytes_used_percent{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"}))

panels.title: MDT inode used % vs 70/85 guardrails
panels.description: MDT inode/file usage. Warning at 70% and critical at 85% per the production best-practices doc.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (subscription_id, resource_group, filesystem_name, location, mdtnum) (azure_managed_lustre_mdt_files_used_percent{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location", mdtnum=~"$mdtnum"}))

panels.title: Total provisioned AMLFS TiB
panels.description: Sum of configured Azure Managed Lustre storage capacity across selected filesystems from Resource Graph inventory.

targets.expr: sum(azure_managed_lustre_filesystem_storage_capacity_tib{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location"})

panels.title: Max metadata amplification
panels.description: Maximum derived metadata amplification ratio across selected filesystems: sum(MDTClientOps) / max(sum(ClientReadOps + ClientWriteOps), 1).

targets.expr: max(azure_managed_lustre_metadata_amplification_ratio{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location"})

panels.title: Max filesystem sample age
panels.description: Maximum derived sample age across selected filesystems. Computed from the oldest OST/MDT sample timestamp seen by the exporter for each filesystem.

targets.expr: max(azure_managed_lustre_filesystem_sample_max_age_seconds{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location"})

panels.title: Total filesystem clients
panels.description: Sum of the derived per-filesystem client count across the current selection (azure_managed_lustre_filesystem_connected_clients = max MDTConnectedClients per filesystem). Replaces the legacy stat that summed max-by-filesystem of the raw MDTConnectedClients gauge in the Client connections row.

targets.expr: sum(azure_managed_lustre_filesystem_connected_clients{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location"})

panels.title: Metadata amplification ratio trend
panels.description: Top-N filesystems by derived metadata amplification ratio. High values indicate tiny-file storms, stat()/lookup amplification, or directory scans relative to data read/write ops.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name) (azure_managed_lustre_metadata_amplification_ratio{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location"}))

panels.title: Filesystem sample age trend
panels.description: Top-N filesystems by derived Azure Monitor sample age from the exporter. Filesystems with no OST/MDT samples remain visible in the inventory table but do not have a derived sample-age series.

targets.expr: topk($top_n, max by (filesystem_name) (azure_managed_lustre_filesystem_sample_max_age_seconds{job="$job", subscription_id=~"$subscription_id", resource_group=~"$resource_group", filesystem_name=~"$filesystem_name", location=~"$location"}))

list.name: ostnum
list.label: OST (hidden: Azure Monitor exposes aggregate only)

list.name: mdtnum
list.label: MDT (hidden: Azure Monitor exposes aggregate only)

title: Azure Managed Lustre Key Metrics
